subtitle: Out Manila · Fly + cruise
overview: Spend two nights in Shanghai and two nights aboard the Adora Magic City, a 136,000-ton ship with a world-first industrial aesthetic exhibition hall. Sightseeing covers Nanjing Road, The Bund, Xintiandi, Zhang Yuan and the Starbucks Reserve Roastery. Flights are with Philippine Airlines or China Southern Airlines.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 10–14 2026 to Dec 24–28 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

itinerary.title: Manila – Shanghai
items: Fly Manila to Shanghai (PR336 12:20/15:50 or MU212 02:05/05:30).
Visit Nanjing Road and The Bund; view the Oriental Pearl Tower from outside.
Check in to the Shanghai hotel. Meals: B/X/D.

itinerary.title: Shanghai – Embark on the cruise
items: Visit Xintiandi, City God Temple Commercial Mall, Huaihai Road, Wukang Road and Tianan Qianshu.
Complete embarkation at Shanghai Wusongkou International Cruise Terminal (bring original passport and ferry ticket).
Vessel departs 20:00/23:00. Meals: B/L/D, on the cruise ship.

itinerary.title: Sea cruise
items: A full day at sea: global and Chinese dining, live performances, leisure zones, art exhibitions and family entertainment on board.
Meals: B/L/D, on the cruise ship.

itinerary.title: Shanghai – Disembark
items: Ship berths at 09:00; disembark in groups and take the group transfer bus.
Visit Zhang Yuan and Starbucks Reserve Roastery; view the LV Cruise Pop-up Building from outside.
Return to the Shanghai hotel. Meals: B/L/X.

itinerary.title: Shanghai – Manila
items: Hotel breakfast, free time at leisure.
Private transfer to the airport for the flight home (PR337 16:55/20:50 or MU211 21:10/01:00). Meals: B/L/X.

placeDesc.Nanjing Road: Shanghai's best-known shopping street, lined with stores, restaurants and neon signs.
placeDesc.The Bund: Shanghai's riverfront promenade with historic buildings facing the Pudong skyline.
placeDesc.Oriental Pearl Tower: Shanghai's TV tower with its distinctive spheres, admired from outside.
placeDesc.Xintiandi: A Shanghai district of restored stone-gate houses turned into cafes, shops and restaurants.
placeDesc.City God Temple: A traditional temple area in old Shanghai with a commercial mall and bazaar around it.
placeDesc.Huaihai Road: A leading shopping street in Shanghai's former French Concession.
placeDesc.Wukang Road: A tree-lined street in the former French Concession with historic buildings and cafes.
placeDesc.Tianan Qianshu: A Shanghai shopping and dining complex visited on the Day 2 city walk.
placeDesc.Zhang Yuan: A historic Shanghai lane-house compound with shops and cafes, visited on Day 4.
placeDesc.Starbucks Reserve Roastery: Starbucks' large roastery store in Shanghai, visited on Day 4.
placeDesc.Adora Magic City cruise ship: Adora Cruises' 136,000-ton ship, 324 m long, built in China, with an industrial-style exhibition hall.
